title: Leftover Rescue Rate
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=foodwaste:log
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(disposition="rescued",kg,0))) as rescued_kg, sum(kg) as tracked_kg by _time
| eval rescue_pct=round(100*rescued_kg/tracked_kg,1)
| sort - _time
description: Measures how much tracked food is rescued into leftovers or future meals instead of becoming waste.
value: Rescue rate reframes food waste from guilt into an operational habit you can improve week by week.
implementation: Use a `disposition` field on `foodwaste:log` events and calculate weekly rescued percentage.
visualization: Line chart of weekly leftover rescue percentage.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It spots how often food gets saved for later instead of being thrown away.
